name: kb-whisper-base
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-base (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of openai/whisper-base, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.099 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-02-14. Caveat: the WER table is shared across the whole kb-whisper family and the 'OpenAI' row inside the 'base' size block is whisper-base, the same size and the same table - a genuine same-instrument comparison. Swedish only. Card also points at sibling ctranslate2 repos for the converted weights.
